preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of the owner address)

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketinWalleAddress() to set the marketing wallet to attacker's address, then trigger swapAndLiquify to collect accumulated BNB fees. Alternatively, use changeRouterVeslon() if you control the ________ address to mint massive tokens, or use qwidji() to blacklist users and block their transactions.
